newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Sept crude palm oil output up 6.04 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Sept crude palm oil output up 6.04 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 6.04 percent to 864,730 tonnes in September from 815,446 in August and against 777,018 tonnes in September 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Tuesday.
September palm oil exports were 637,079 tonnes against 687,870 in August and 578,772 in September last year, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 1.02 percent to 646,448 tonnes in September from 639,933 in August and 621,991 tonnes in September 1995.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak rose 24.37 percent to 218,282 tonnes in September from 175,513 tonnes in August and against 155,027 tonnes in September 1995.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production rose 4.64 percent to 100,490 tonnes in September from 96,034 in August and against 93,722 tonnes in September last year.
